body:
_Verify that session ids stored in cookies have their path set to an appropriately restrictive value for the application, and authentication session tokens additionally set the “HttpOnly” and “secure” attributes_

Suggested
Verify that session IDs stored in cookies are scoped using the 'path' attribute; and have the 'HttpOnly' and 'Secure' cookie flags enabled.

N.B.
This may be impossible for API based apps, perhaps a link to design pattern or shift ID to HTTP header is a better approach.
